name: Miyuki Sawashiro
about:
Hometown: Tokyo, Japan
Blood type: O
Hobbies: piano
Nicknames: みゆきち (Miyukichi), シロロン (Shiroron)
Debut role: Puchi Charat (Di Gi Charat)

She began her voice-acting career in 1999 and has continued her work as a seiyuu for more than two decades.

She is the older sister of seiyuu Chiharu Sawashiro.

Married on June 2, 2014, her 29th birthday.
